en.headline: Government issues practice note for bonus plot ratio pilot scheme starting 1 September
en.dek: Developers redeveloping qualifying old residential buildings in seven designated districts can obtain an extra 20 per cent plot ratio free of land premium for five years.
body: The Development Bureau, Planning Department, Lands Department and Buildings Department on Wednesday issued a joint practice note setting out the requirements for the Bonus Plot Ratio Pilot Scheme that will take effect on 1 September.

Under the five-year scheme, which runs until 31 August 2031, a developer that undertakes to demolish residential buildings aged 50 years or above on a site of not less than 700 square metres in one of seven designated older districts and redevelop for residential use may receive an additional 20 per cent of total floor area free of land premium. The districts are Cheung Sha Wan (including Sham Shui Po), Ma Tau Kok (including Kowloon City and To Kwa Wan), Mong Kok, Sai Ying Pun and Sheung Wan, Tsuen Wan, Wan Chai and Yau Ma Tei.

Developers may either apply to the Town Planning Board to increase the site’s plot ratio by up to 20 per cent, or convert the bonus into a land-value credit that can offset premiums payable on the same project or other land transactions across Hong Kong, including the Northern Metropolis, for up to ten years. Lands Department will accept lease modification applications during the pilot period and will impose conditions including rebuilding deadlines and penalties.

zh.headline: 額外地積比率先導計劃9月生效 聯合作業備考詳列安排
zh.dek: 發展商在七個指定舊區拆卸樓齡50年或以上、地盤不少於700平方米的住宅樓宇並重建作住宅用途，可獲額外20%免補地價總樓面面積，計劃為期五年。
body: 發展局、規劃署、地政總署及屋宇署周三發出聯合作業備考，詳列將於9月1日生效的「額外地積比率先導計劃」要求與安排。
計劃為期五年，至2031年8月31日止。發展商如承諾拆卸位於七個指定舊區、樓齡達50年或以上、地盤面積不少於700平方米的住宅樓宇，並重建作住宅用途，可獲額外20%免補地價總樓面面積。七區包括長沙灣（涵蓋深水埗）、馬頭角（包括九龍城及土瓜灣）、旺角、西營盤及上環、荃灣、灣仔和油麻地。
發展商可選擇向城規會申請加大原址可建總樓面面積上限20%，或將額外地積比率轉化為地價價值，用以抵銷同一項目或其他土地交易須支付的地價，有效期十年。地政總署會在計劃期內接受契約修訂申請，並施加重建限期及罰則等條件。
